描述_EN: it usually had a set of matching chair covers. a table frontal covered the front, sides and legs of a table but not the top. in 17th-century china guests at a banquet usually sat behind individual small tables rather than round a large table as a group. this table frontal would have been used for dinner parties. the back of the table was left free so that a person could sit at it comfortably.
描述_ZN: 它通常有一套配套的椅套。 一张桌子的正面覆盖了桌子的正面、侧面和腿部，但不是顶部。 在17世纪的中国，参加宴会的客人通常坐在个别的小桌子后面，而不是围着一张大桌子。 这种桌子的正面会被用于晚餐聚会。 桌子的背面是空出来的，这样一个人就可以舒适地坐在上面。
